_frozen_note: frozen_sha256 covers tone_model, tags, aggregation and preregistered_rule. backtest.py refuses to run if any of them changes, unless --acknowledge-rule-change is passed, and then the report says so.

tone_model.description: Deterministic tone score on a -2..+2 integer scale. Text tone from VADER (title + body) is blended with the star rating; both components are kept in tone_scores.csv.
tone_model.rounding: round half away from zero, then clip to [-2, 2]

tags.other_rule: a review scored -1 or -2 with none of defect / quality_decline / price / seller_shipping is tagged other
tags.seller_shipping_only_rule: seller_shipping matched and no defect, quality_decline, price or product_terms matched: excluded from product tone, counted separately

aggregation.baseline_requires: all prior quarters non-sparse with complete coverage; otherwise the baseline is left blank (never imputed)

coverage_flags.complete: every product's fetched history reaches back past the quarter start, and the quarter has ended
coverage_flags.partial_quarter: the quarter has not ended as of the run date
coverage_flags.truncated: at least one product hit the source's result cap and its earliest fetched review is after the quarter start

preregistered_rule.question: Does a quarter's Amazon review tone, relative to its own recent history, lead the next quarter's change in SEC-reported revenue growth?
preregistered_rule.signal: composite_tone_delta[q] = mean over eligible sources of (mean_tone[q] - mean(mean_tone[q-4..q-1]))
preregistered_rule.eligible_quarter: non-sparse, coverage complete, prior-4-quarter baseline present (thresholds in 'aggregation')
preregistered_rule.primary_target: sign(revenue_yoy[q+1] - revenue_yoy[q]); DOWN is a hit if negative, UP is a hit if positive, exactly zero is a miss
preregistered_rule.secondary_target: nowcast sign(revenue_yoy[q] - revenue_yoy[q-1]); reported only, never counted
preregistered_rule.revenue_source: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, first-filed value per fiscal quarter; fiscal Q4 = annual 10-K value minus Q1..Q3 10-Q values
preregistered_rule.holdout_selection: the 8 most recent eligible quarters whose q+1 revenue has been filed with the SEC
baselines_for_comparison: persistence: predict sign(revenue_yoy[q-1] - revenue_yoy[q-2]), the last acceleration known when quarter q ends
preregistered_rule.statistics: hit rate on calls; one-sided exact binomial p-value against 50%; with at most 8 quarters this has almost no statistical power and is reported as such
preregistered_rule.no_fitting: Thresholds were fixed before any data was collected. Nothing is estimated from the holdout quarters.
